D.t: Henry Cuellar leads by 12.5 in the forecast and wins 98% of simulations. The cushion is about 32,813 votes; a one point swing is about 1,314 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +4.4 and D +20.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
